fields.name: cement_type
fields.rationale: The cement type is explicitly mentioned as CEM III/A 52,5 N, which is a specific classification of cement according to EN 197-1.
evidence: Holcim Duo 5 N ist ein Hochofenzement CEM III/A 52,5 N der gemäß EN 197-1 hergestellt und überwacht wird.

fields.name: production_location
fields.rationale: The production location is explicitly stated as the Dortmund plant, which is relevant for understanding the geographical context of the product's manufacturing.
evidence: Holcim Duo 5 N is manufactured at the Dortmund plant.

fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key material property that affects the performance and application of cement in construction.

fields.name: hydration_reaction
fields.rationale: The text describes the hydration reaction as a key process in the hardening of cement, which is a critical functional property.
evidence: Nach Zugabe von Wasser zum Zement entsteht eine Suspension (Zementleim), die aufgrund einsetzender Hydratationsreaktion sowohl an der Luft als auch unter Wasser erstarrt und erhärtet sowie dauerhaft fest bleibt.
inference_basis: Hydration reaction is a fundamental process in cement hardening.

fields.name: blast_furnace_slag_content
fields.rationale: The use of blast furnace slag is mentioned as a component in the cement, indicating its presence as a material property.
evidence: Production of blast furnace slag During the production of pig iron in the blast furnace process, liquid blast furnace slag is produced as a by-product.
inference_basis: Blast furnace slag is commonly used in CEM III type cements.
